pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zuìhòu yìkǔn kōng mádài tuō dào qiángbiān , zuòzài shàngmiàn , bùxiǎng zài zhàn qǐlái .
pairs.english: Tavi dragged the last bundle of empty sacks to the wall and sat on it, not wanting to stand again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把最后一捆空麻袋拖到墙边，坐在上面，不想再站起来。

pairs.target: zhè shì shěnlǐ hòu de dìsāntiān .
pairs.english: It was the third day after the hearing.
pairs.hanzi: 这是审理后的第三天。

pairs.target: tā yuánběn lúnxiū , huòzhàn què quē rén qīngkù , guǎnshì dāying zuò wán zhè bàntiān lìng jié qián .
pairs.english: He was due a rest day, but the freight station needed people to clear the storehouse; the foreman promised separate pay for finishing this half day's work.
pairs.hanzi: 他原本轮休，货站却缺人清库，管事答应做完这半天另结钱。

pairs.target: tā lái yǐqián suàn guò , bùnéng bǎ běnlái jiùyào zhèng de gōngqián zài suàn yíbiàn ,
pairs.english: He had worked it out before coming: he could not count wages he would earn anyway a second time,
pairs.hanzi: 他来以前算过，不能把本来就要挣的工钱再算一遍，

pairs.target: gèng bùnéng zhǐwàng qù le bái jiē yǐhòu háiyǒu zhè bàntiān .
pairs.english: still less could he expect to have this half day once he went to White Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 更不能指望去了白阶以后还有这半天。

pairs.target: sānméi tóngqián zài zhǎngxīn liúxià le yuán yìn .
pairs.english: Three copper coins left round marks in his palm.
pairs.hanzi: 三枚铜钱在掌心留下了圆印。

pairs.target: tā yòng yījiǎo cājìng hàn , qǐshēn huíjiā .
pairs.english: He wiped away the sweat with his shirt hem and got up to go home.
pairs.hanzi: 他用衣角擦净汗，起身回家。

pairs.target: sè lā zuòzài ménbiān bāo yàngpǐn .
pairs.english: Sela sat by the door wrapping samples.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉坐在门边包样品。

pairs.target: xī shàng diàn zhe mùbǎn , bǎn shàng shì yìpái xìxiǎo de kuàngshí ,
pairs.english: A board rested on her knees, holding a row of tiny mineral samples;
pairs.hanzi: 膝上垫着木板，板上是一排细小的矿石，

pairs.target: měikuài dōu yào xiān guǒ ruǎnbù , zài bāo zhǐ , miǎnde léngjiǎo huàpò wài dài .
pairs.english: each needed soft cloth first, then paper, to keep its edges from cutting the outer bag.
pairs.hanzi: 每块都要先裹软布，再包纸，免得棱角划破外袋。

pairs.target: tā lǐngdào de shì liǎnghuí huó lǐ de dìyīhuí ,
pairs.english: She had secured the first of the two jobs,
pairs.hanzi: 她领到的是两回活里的第一回，

pairs.target: lǐngliào shí yǐ shuōhǎo jià , dìèrhuí réng méi dìng .
pairs.english: agreeing on the price when collecting the materials; the second was still uncertain.
pairs.hanzi: 领料时已说好价，第二回仍没定。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shēnshǒu , bèi tā dǎngzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi tried to reach in, but she stopped him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想伸手，被她挡住。

pairs.target: " xiānxǐ . nǐ yì mō , wǒ hái dé huànzhǐ . "
pairs.english: “Wash first. If you touch it, I'll have to change the paper.”
pairs.hanzi: “先洗。你一摸，我还得换纸。”

pairs.target: tā xǐwán huílái , sè lā ràng tā niēzhù zhǐ jiǎo , zìjǐ ràoxiàn .
pairs.english: When he came back washed, Sela had him hold a paper corner while she wound the thread.
pairs.hanzi: 他洗完回来，瑟拉让他捏住纸角，自己绕线。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi búguò shì bāo qǐlái , shōujǐn shí què ràng shí jiān chuān chū yígè dòng .
pairs.english: He thought it was only wrapping, but when he tightened it, the stone's point poked a hole through.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为不过是包起来，收紧时却让石尖穿出一个洞。

pairs.target: sè lā méi shuō tā , jiāng nà kuài tuìhuí bù duī lǐ , lìng tiāo le yípiàn hòu de diàn shàng .
pairs.english: Sela did not scold him; she returned that piece to the cloth pile and chose a thick scrap for padding.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉没说他，将那块退回布堆里，另挑了一片厚的垫上。

pairs.target: dào shōu liào de rén lái , shèngxià de yǐjīng bǎiqí .
pairs.english: By the time the collector arrived, the rest were all set out.
pairs.hanzi: 到收料的人来，剩下的已经摆齐。

pairs.target: duìfāng chāikāi liǎngbāo yàn guò , yòu zhúyī duì le shù , cái fùqián .
pairs.english: The collector opened two packets to inspect them, then checked the count one by one before paying.
pairs.hanzi: 对方拆开两包验过，又逐一对了数，才付钱。

pairs.target: sè lā méiyǒu jiāng tóngqián lìkè tuī dào jiāyòng wǎn lǐ ,
pairs.english: Sela did not immediately push the copper coins into the household money bowl;
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉没有将铜钱立刻推到家用碗里，

pairs.target: xiān ràng tǎ wéi bǎ sàn zài dìshàng de suìzhǐ sǎo jìng .
pairs.english: first she had Tavi sweep up the paper scraps scattered on the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 先让塔维把散在地上的碎纸扫净。

pairs.target: nàtiān bàngwǎn , bó yà zài láishí , zhuōshàng zhōngyú méiyǒu kuàngshí le .
pairs.english: When Boya returned that evening, the table was finally clear of mineral samples.
pairs.hanzi: 那天傍晚，博娅再来时，桌上终于没有矿石了。

pairs.target: tā qián wǎn yǐ bǎ xīn ná huí de fùbiǎo niàn guò liǎngbiàn ,
pairs.english: She had read the newly obtained schedule twice the evening before last;
pairs.hanzi: 她前晚已把新拿回的附表念过两遍，

pairs.target: jīntiān tì tāmen hé zuìhòu yìzhāng jiāyòng zhàng .
pairs.english: today she was checking their final household budget.
pairs.hanzi: 今天替他们核最后一张家用账。

pairs.target: liùzhōu méiyǒu gōngqián , tǎ wéi zài xuégōng chī zhù , jiāzhōng biàn shǎo zuò tā nà fènfàn ;
pairs.english: Six weeks without wages; Tavi would eat and sleep at the academy, so the household would no longer cook his share;
pairs.hanzi: 六周没有工钱，塔维在学宫吃住，家中便少做他那份饭；

pairs.target: shěng xià de yǐjīng kòuguò , bùnéng zài kòu .
pairs.english: those savings were already deducted and could not be deducted again.
pairs.hanzi: 省下的已经扣过，不能再扣。

pairs.target: xiàgèyuè hái chà sānméi , yúxià bàngè yuè chà liǎngméi .
pairs.english: They were still short three coins for next month and two for the remaining half month.
pairs.hanzi: 下个月还差三枚，余下半个月差两枚。

pairs.target: sè lā jiāng bāo liào zhèng de liǎngméi fàngxià . tǎ wéi fàngxià zìjǐ de sānméi .
pairs.english: Sela put down the two she had earned wrapping samples. Tavi put down his three.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉将包料挣的两枚放下。塔维放下自己的三枚。

pairs.target: wǔméi jǐ zài zhuōmiàn yíchù āohén lǐ , méiyǒu yìméi néng liúxià zuò xiánqián .
pairs.english: The five crowded into a dent in the tabletop; not one could be kept as spare money.
pairs.hanzi: 五枚挤在桌面一处凹痕里，没有一枚能留下作闲钱。

pairs.target: " zhè zhī dào shì dúwán . " bó yà shuō .
pairs.english: “This only gets you to the end of the trial,” Boya said.
pairs.hanzi: “这只到试读完。”博娅说。

pairs.target: " zhīdào . " sè lā dá , " dìèrhuí bāo liào de qián búsuàn jìnqù . "
pairs.english: “We know,” Sela replied. “The money for the second wrapping job isn't counted.”
pairs.hanzi: “知道。”瑟拉答，“第二回包料的钱不算进去。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe nà wǔméi qián .
pairs.english: Tavi gazed at the five coins.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着那五枚钱。

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng shuō zìjǐ dào xuéxiào yě kěyǐ zhǎo huó ,
pairs.english: He had wanted to say he could find work at school too,
pairs.hanzi: 他本想说自己到学校也可以找活，

pairs.target: yòu xiǎngqǐ nài lěi shuō guò , dìyīduàn rìzi lián shénme shíhòu néng xiē dōu bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: then remembered Nerai saying he would not even know when he could rest during those first days.
pairs.hanzi: 又想起奈蕾说过，第一段日子连什么时候能歇都不知道。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā méiyǒu gěi zhuōshàng tiān yígè hái bù cúnzài de zìjǐ .
pairs.english: This time he did not add to the table a version of himself that did not yet exist.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他没有给桌上添一个还不存在的自己。

pairs.target: " méi ne ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “What about coal?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “煤呢？”他问。

pairs.target: sè lā cóng mén hòu qǔchū yì jié jiù shéng .
pairs.english: Sela took a length of old rope from behind the door.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉从门后取出一截旧绳。

pairs.target: tā xiàwǔ gēn gébì liǎngjiā tán guò ,
pairs.english: She had spoken that afternoon with the two neighboring households:
pairs.hanzi: 她下午跟隔壁两家谈过，

pairs.target: qǐng bān méi de rén yícì sòngdào gòngyòng de píng jiē , sānjiā fēntān zhè yíduàn de qián , yǐ jì zài zhàng lǐ .
pairs.english: the coal carrier would make one delivery to their shared landing, with all three households splitting that stretch's cost, already entered in the budget.
pairs.hanzi: 请搬煤的人一次送到共用的平阶，三家分摊这一段的钱，已记在账里。

pairs.target: yúxià de jǐjí táijiē , línjiā de dà nǚér kěn dāshǒu ,
pairs.english: For the few steps left, the neighbors' eldest daughter was willing to help,
pairs.hanzi: 余下的几级台阶，邻家的大女儿肯搭手，

pairs.target: huàn sè lā tì tā gǎi yíjiàn duǎn le de wàiyī .
pairs.english: in exchange for Sela altering a coat she had outgrown.
pairs.hanzi: 换瑟拉替她改一件短了的外衣。

pairs.target: " wǒ wèn le tā , búshì zhī wèn tā niáng . " sè lā shuō ,
pairs.english: “I asked her, not just her mother,” Sela said.
pairs.hanzi: “我问了她，不是只问她娘。”瑟拉说，

pairs.target: " yìhuí bān bù wán jiù fēn liǎnghuí , bié gǎnzhe yòng fànshí jiào tā . "
pairs.english: “If one trip isn't enough, she'll make two. Don't call her right at mealtime.”
pairs.hanzi: “一回搬不完就分两回，别赶着用饭时叫她。”

pairs.target: ā duó sòng búdào shuǐ de rìzi , yě yǔ línjiā cuòkāi le qǔshuǐ de shíchén .
pairs.english: On days Ado could not deliver water, they had also staggered their water-collecting times with the neighbors.
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎送不到水的日子，也与邻家错开了取水的时辰。

pairs.target: sè lā yòng xiǎo guàn qù fēn , bù tí zhěngtǒng .
pairs.english: Sela would collect her share in a small jar instead of carrying a whole bucket.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉用小罐去分，不提整桶。

pairs.target: tā jiāng jiù shéng bǐ zài guàn ěr shàng , yào dǎ yígè bú lè shǒu de tíhuán .
pairs.english: She held the old rope against the jar's handles to make a loop that would not cut into her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她将旧绳比在罐耳上，要打一个不勒手的提环。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu ná shéng , zhècì tā gěi le tā .
pairs.english: Tavi reached for the rope, and this time she gave it to him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手拿绳，这次她给了他。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shéng tóu chuānguò guàn ěr , ràohuí zhǎngzhōng .
pairs.english: He threaded the rope end through the jar's handle and looped it back into his palm.
pairs.hanzi: 他把绳头穿过罐耳，绕回掌中。

pairs.target: zhège jié shì sè lā jiào de , tā xiǎoshíhòu dǎ dé tàijǐn , qǔshuǐ shí jiěbùkāi ,
pairs.english: Sela had taught him this knot; as a child he tied it too tightly to undo when collecting water,
pairs.hanzi: 这个结是瑟拉教的，他小时候打得太紧，取水时解不开，

pairs.target: tā biàn ràng tā yìbiān mà yìbiān zìjǐ chāi .
pairs.english: and she would let him curse as he unpicked it himself.
pairs.hanzi: 她便让他一边骂一边自己拆。

pairs.target: rújīn tā kànzhe tā de shǒu , méiyǒu zài zhǐ nǎ yìtóu gāi yā zài nǎ yì tóushàng .
pairs.english: Now she watched his hands without showing him again which end should go over which.
pairs.hanzi: 如今她看着他的手，没有再指哪一头该压在哪一头上。

pairs.target: " yàoshi xīgài téng dé zǒu bùliǎo ne ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “What if your knees hurt too much to walk?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “要是膝盖疼得走不了呢？”他问。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: The room was quiet for a while.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了一会儿。

pairs.target: sè lā bǎ dèngzǐ wǎng zào biān nuó le nuó .
pairs.english: Sela shifted her stool toward the stove.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉把凳子往灶边挪了挪。

pairs.target: " wǒhuì qǐng rén sòngxìn . nǐ yě dé huí .
pairs.english: “I'll ask someone to send a letter. You must answer too.
pairs.hanzi: “我会请人送信。你也得回。

pairs.target: bié dào le nàbiān , jiù juéde xiě yíjù méishì néng bǎ shì xiāodiào . "
pairs.english: Don't get there and think that writing 'everything is fine' will make things go away.”
pairs.hanzi: 别到了那边，就觉得写一句没事能把事消掉。”

pairs.target: " huílái de lù qián ——"
pairs.english: “The fare back—”
pairs.hanzi: “回来的路钱——”

pairs.target: " lìng fàng zhe . " tā zhǐ le zhǐ wǎndǐ yā zhe de xiǎo bùbāo ,
pairs.english: “Set aside.” She pointed to the small cloth packet tucked under the bowl.
pairs.hanzi: “另放着。”她指了指碗底压着的小布包，

pairs.target: " zhège méi dòng . nǐ huílái yàoshi wèile kàn wǒ , bùnéng xiān děng wǒ bǎ chēqián jìgěi nǐ . "
pairs.english: “We haven't touched this. If you're coming back to see me, you can't wait for me to send you the cart fare first.”
pairs.hanzi: “这个没动。你回来要是为了看我，不能先等我把车钱寄给你。”

pairs.target: bó yà bǎ bǐ gēxià , ràng tāmen zìjǐ bǎ zuìhòu liǎngxiàng hé yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Boya set her pen down and had them check the last two items themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅把笔搁下，让他们自己把最后两项核一遍。

pairs.target: dēngxīn jié le yìdiǎn hēi huā , tǎ wéi ná xì qiān tiāo diào , huǒmiáo ānjìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: A little black bloom had formed on the wick; Tavi picked it off with a thin splinter, and the flame settled.
pairs.hanzi: 灯芯结了一点黑花，塔维拿细签挑掉，火苗安静下来。

pairs.target: nàzhǎn bú màoyān de dēng yòu fú dào tā nǎozǐlǐ , zhè yìhuí pángbiān hái tiān le huì chuī dízǐ de tóng ké .
pairs.english: The smokeless lamp rose in his mind again, this time joined by the copper casing that could whistle.
pairs.hanzi: 那盏不冒烟的灯又浮到他脑子里，这一回旁边还添了会吹笛子的铜壳。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shéngjié lājǐn , bǎ kōng guàn tíqǐ , zài qīngqīng fàngxià .
pairs.english: He tightened the knot, lifted the empty jar, and gently put it down again.
pairs.hanzi: 他将绳结拉紧，把空罐提起，再轻轻放下。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng qù shì liùzhōu . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I want to go and try for six weeks,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “我想去试六周。”他说。

pairs.target: sè lā dītóu mōlemō tíhuán , diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Sela looked down, felt the carrying loop, and nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉低头摸了摸提环，点头。

pairs.target: " nà jiù qù . zhèngshì liúxià yǐqián , zánmen zài suàn ,
pairs.english: “Then go. Before you stay on formally, we'll work it out again.
pairs.hanzi: “那就去。正式留下以前，咱们再算，

pairs.target: bié bǎ jīntiān shuō dehuà dàngchéng wǎnghòu shénme dōu dāying le . "
pairs.english: Don't take what we've said today as agreement to everything that comes later.”
pairs.hanzi: 别把今天说的话当成往后什么都答应了。”

pairs.target: bó yà chóngxīn ná qǐbǐ , zài zhǐ shàng xiě hǎo dáfù de rìqī , liúchū tā qiānmíng de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Boya picked up her pen again, wrote the date of the reply on the paper, and left a space for his signature.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅重新拿起笔，在纸上写好答复的日期，留出他签名的地方。

pairs.target: míngtiān zǎoshàng , tā háiyào qīnzì sòng qù .
pairs.english: Tomorrow morning he would have to deliver it himself still.
pairs.hanzi: 明天早上，他还要亲自送去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiě dé màn . zuìhòu yìbǐ méiyǒu gǎn , mò yě méiyǒu yīn kāi .
pairs.english: Tavi wrote slowly. He did not rush the final stroke, and the ink did not bleed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维写得慢。最后一笔没有赶，墨也没有洇开。

pairs.target: sè lā bǎ nà zhāng zhǐ yí yuǎn xiē , miǎnde shǒuzhǒu cā dào , suíhòu cóng zhuōxià tuō chū yìzhī jiù xiāng .
pairs.english: Sela moved the paper farther away from stray elbows, then dragged an old chest from under the table.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉把那张纸移远些，免得手肘擦到，随后从桌下拖出一只旧箱。

pairs.target: " xiànzài kěyǐ kàn nǐ dàodǐ yǒu jǐjiàn yīfu le . "
pairs.english: “Now we can see how many clothes you actually have.”
pairs.hanzi: “现在可以看你到底有几件衣服了。”

pairs.target: tā dūnxià jiēkāi xiāng gài , yìzhī zǎojiù zhǎo búdào de wàzi cóng fènglǐ diào chūlái .
pairs.english: He crouched and lifted the lid, and a long-lost sock fell out of a gap.
pairs.hanzi: 他蹲下揭开箱盖，一只早就找不到的袜子从缝里掉出来。

pairs.target: sè lā jiǎnqǐlái , duì zhe dēng kàn nàge pòdòng , rěn le rěn , háishì xiào le .
pairs.english: Sela picked it up, held the hole to the light, tried to resist, and laughed anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉捡起来，对着灯看那个破洞，忍了忍，还是笑了。
